crossRefs.note: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in…
In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and…
He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…
Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

translations.web: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
translations.bsb: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
translations.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
translations.asv: But I will warn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
